meta.title: Ticketing Outcome: refused for a user without the Requester / End User role
gaps: Use Ticketing Outcome to generate an id for a standard-approval intake.
Compare refusal or absence for a user without the Requester / End User role against availability for a Requester / End User.
Sign in as the two role-specific users on the same Growth tenant.
Verify or change the tenant's Growth plan configuration because no tenant identifier is provided.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Use Ticketing Outcome to generate an id for a standard-approval intake.; Compare refusal or absence for a user without the Requester / End User role against availability for a Requester / End User.; Sign in as the two role-specific users on the same Growth tenant.; Verify or change the tenant's Growth plan configuration because no tenant identifier is provided.

args.need: sign in as the user without the Requester / End User role, attempt Ticketing Outcome for a standard-approval intake and record whether it is refused or absent, then repeat as a Requester / End User on the same Growth tenant and record whether it is available

steps.note: The catalog cannot authenticate as alternate role-specific users or operate Ticketing Outcome.
Ensure the session has no visible crash or server error after the tester's comparison.
